resources.string: Off: use the built-in computer keyboard. Chinese input uses the remote input method.
Long press to drag, two-finger tap to right-click, swipe to pan, two fingers to scroll
Keep scrolling briefly after a quick two-finger swipe. Touch again to stop.

Tap to click; double-tap to double-click. Long press and drag, or double-tap and hold to drag. Two-finger tap right-clicks; two-finger swipe scrolls; pinch zooms. Swipe with one finger to pan the view. Open and close the keyboard manually.
